positive_snippets: The staff were incredible, the best service I have received at a bed and breakfast. The breakfast was super tasty, loved the cake and fruit. The location was great it was like a little sheltered area in the middle of Delhi. It was easy to access the train and the village, but it felt private while we were there! 10/10!

I love staying at the Estate Villa! It is the perfect place to explore the lively city of Delhi while having a relaxing home to recharge. The yard has wonderful plants, charming patio furniture, and many beautiful birds. My partner and I enjoyed our delicious breakfasts outside while listening to the birds and soaking in the sun. The rooms were always cleaned very well, and the staff was extremely friendly. I highly recommend staying at the Estate Villa, I always do when I travel to India.

Services were so good. Rooms are kinda old ..but well mantained with neat washroom. The only thing i felt was ..there is no bedside plug but i think they will make the necessary arrangements soon .I was here for 5 nights and the experience was just wow.Walkable distance to metro station. The entry is through a market road ...was kinda ok for me , but just 500m away from the main highway. U wont expect such a peaceful place in that rush.
If u are looking for a peaceful stay to be relaxed ..but not that away from the main roads/metros ... this is the place. GO FOR IT.
All the staffs were so nice , special thanks to Amy who helped me with the things there .
